exposure: Physiological and pathological changes in placental oxygenation
Pre-eclampsia cases delivered before and after 34 weeks gestation
outcome: Release of factors affecting maternal endothelium
Role of soluble FLT1 (sFLT1) in pre-eclampsia
finding: The human placenta adapts to oxygenation changes, with pathological conditions like pre-eclampsia leading to placental stress and release of factors affecting maternal endothelium, potentially contributing to the maternal syndrome.
gest_age: First trimester, term, and pre-eclampsia cases delivered before and after 34 weeks gestation
